"""
Task methods for creating service inquiries with dynamic customer contact data. Workflow: navigate to inquiries → create new inquiry → search/create customer contact → fill inquiry form (type: Service, source: Email, status: New) → save.

This module provides high-level task methods that orchestrate page objects
to accomplish business workflows.
"""

from interfaces.web_interface import WebInterface
from resources.utilities import autologger
from framework.pages.helios1.inquiries_page import InquiriesPage


class InquiryTasks:
    """
    Task module for General operations.

    - @autologger("Task") on all methods
    - NO decorator on constructor
    - Composes Page Objects
    - One domain operation per method
    - NO return values
    - Uses fluent POM API
    """

    def __init__(self, web: WebInterface):
        """
        Compose Page Objects - NO decorator on constructor.

        Args:
            web: WebInterface instance
        """
        self.web = web
        self.inquiries_page = InquiriesPage(web)

    # ==================== TASK METHODS ====================

    @autologger.automation_logger("Task")
    def create_inquiry(self, customer_name: str, contact_name: str, contact_email: str, 
                       inquiry_type: str, inquiry_source: str, inquiry_status: str,
                       subject: str, description: str) -> None:
        """
        Create a new service inquiry with customer contact information.

        NO return value - test asserts via POM state-check methods.
        """
        # Navigate and initiate new inquiry
        (self.inquiries_page
            .navigate()
            .click_new_inquiry_button())
        
        # Search/create customer contact
        (self.inquiries_page
            .enter_customer_name(customer_name)
            .click_customer_search_button()
            .enter_contact_name(contact_name)
            .enter_contact_email(contact_email)
            .click_new_contact_button()
            .enter_new_contact_name(contact_name)
            .enter_new_contact_email(contact_email)
            .click_save_contact_button())
        
        # Fill inquiry form
        (self.inquiries_page
            .enter_inquiry_type(inquiry_type)
            .enter_inquiry_source(inquiry_source)
            .enter_inquiry_status(inquiry_status)
            .enter_subject(subject)
            .enter_description(description)
            .click_save_inquiry_button())
        # NO return - test asserts via POM
